why: Each figure is the hexagon with more small tails and hooks added, and every new figure keeps all the parts of the one before it. B adds a hook at the bottom-right corner and a line at the top-left. C keeps all of these and adds a hook at the bottom-left corner and a tail on the left side, giving the bottom two curls of option 4. D then adds more parts on the left. Options 2 and 3 change the bottom-right hook of B into other shapes, so they break the build-up.
trick: In growing figures, the answer must keep every part of the figure before it; cross out options that lose a part.
note: Many small hooks; drawing is an approximation of the scan details.
